verdict.rationale: Bolt.new lets founders skip a blank prompt by importing existing work: pulling in a GitHub repo, a Lovable project, or Figma/Google Stitch designs to bootstrap an app (bolt-docs-4, bolt-docs-5, bolt-docs-6, bolt-docs-7). This covers the 'community project' import half of the story, but there's no evidence of a curated template gallery or starter-project library to pick from. Missing for 10: an explicit template gallery/starter-kit catalog, and independent user confirmation that imported projects work smoothly as a starting point.
